done_when: forge-pr-check reports pending, not failure, on a pull request that has no committed review yet, and still fails on a stale or blocked review; a test covers the generated workflow on a new and an adopted repo

known.title: [P1] Preserve review refusal messages in failed-step logs

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Functional
`continue-on-error` makes the review step's final conclusion successful ([GitHub contract](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/contexts#steps-context)), so [`gh --log-failed` excludes its diagnostics](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/trunk/pkg/cmd/run/view/logs.go#L108-L110). For stale or blocked reviews, only the reporter fails, without printing the actual refusal. Both `src/forge/worker.py:474` and `src/forge/land.py:229` read failed-step logs; consequently, the stale-review recovery at `src/forge/land.py:96–101` cannot recognize the refusal, and workers lose the failure reason. The same problem exists in `.github/workflows/forge.yml:96`. Preserve the refusal in the failed reporter's log or update the readers. The new test checks only the diagnostic URL, so it misses this failure.
findings.title: [P1] Preserve review refusal messages in failed-step logs

why: On every pull request the forge-pr-check fails on the first push and passes only after the committed review lands, so every pull request shows a red check first (issue 976)
